title: Vividly Grilled Italian Sausage Skewers
description: A malty and chewy British dish featuring Italian fennel sausages, this recipe is perfect for a show-off dinner party and can be cooked on a robata grill, making it a great option for a special occasion, the dish is also buddhist-temple-friendly as it does not contain any non-vegetarian ingredients other than the sausage

ingredients.name: Italian fennel sausages
ingredients.notes: sweet Italian sausage with fennel seeds

instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a small bowl, whisk together malt vinegar and olive oil
Thread Italian fennel sausages onto skewers, leaving a small space between each sausage
Brush the skewers with the malt vinegar and olive oil mixture
Season with salt, black pepper, and minced garlic
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until the sausages are cooked through
Steam the skewers over boiling water for an additional 2 minutes to achieve a mushimono-steam effect
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges on the side
